context.projectOverview: agent-bober pluggable graph backend, Sprint 3. Sprints 1-2 (ae1bde7, 129d841) built the full GraphBackend abstraction: id + searchPlan/queryPlan/impactPlan/reviewContextPlan/overviewPlan/changesPlan (tool/params/narrow) + processSpec/prereqSpec/cliMap. The transport, prereq check, and CLI wrapper all take an injected backend; construction sites currently hardcode `new TokensaveBackend()`. Sprint 3 makes selection dynamic: add optional config `graph.backend` + `resolveGraphBackend()` that auto-detects the installed binary (tokensave preferred), wire all 5 construction sites, register a CodeReviewGraphBackend STUB (specs only, adapters throw/TODO), and evolve the manifest additively (backend + backendVersion).

completedSprints.title: process/prereq/CLI specs + transport param
completedSprints.summary: GraphBackend gained processSpec/prereqSpec/cliMap; transport/prereq/cli driven by backend. 129d841.

keyNotes: Add `graph.backend: z.enum(['tokensave','code-review-graph']).optional()` and `codeReviewGraphPath: z.string().optional()` to GraphSectionSchema (~394-417). Optional => a config without them must validate identically (there is a dogfood golden config snapshot in the repo — if a snapshot test compares default output, update it ONLY if genuinely needed; backend is optional so default output should be unchanged).

resolveGraphBackend(config, {probe?}) — explicit graph.backend wins (no probe of the other); else probe each backend's prereqSpec.versionArgs via an INJECTABLE probe(binary,args)->{ok,version}; tokensave wins when both installed; combined install hint (both engines) when neither. Keep probe injectable so unit tests need no real binary.

CodeReviewGraphBackend STUB: real id 'code-review-graph', processSpec {binary:'code-review-graph', serveArgs:['serve']}, prereqSpec {versionArgs:['--version'], isCompatible: accept-any (documented TODO), installHint:'pip install code-review-graph'}, cliMap TODO; the *Plan adapter methods THROW or return a TODO marker (filled Sprints 4-6). It only needs to be selectable + prereq-checkable now.

Wire ALL FIVE construction sites (pipeline-lifecycle.ts, mcp/server.ts, cli/impact.ts, cli/graph.ts, cli/onboard.ts) to `resolveGraphBackend(config,...)` then pass the backend down. With graph.backend unset + tokensave installed, byte-identical to today.

Manifest additive: GraphManifest + GraphArtifactStore gain backend + backendVersion; reading a legacy manifest (no backend) defaults backend='tokensave', backendVersion=tokensaveVersion. Keep writing tokensaveVersion.
The pipeline-lifecycle stub GraphSection (~230-248) hardcodes config — ensure it doesn't override the resolved backend (backend is a separate injected dep from GraphSection config).

principles: TypeScript strict, zero type errors. ESM .js imports, `import type`, no `any`, no sync fs, unicode section headers, Zod for config, conventional commits `bober(sprint-N): ...`. Never main. Full-suite baseline entering this sprint: 4994 passed / 1 skipped / 0 failures.
